_comment: Pre-crafted demo responses. Triggers are checked in order — first match wins.

policy_clause.title: Violence and Incitement
policy_clause.section: I. Violence and Criminal Behavior — 1. Violence and Incitement
policy_clause.text: We remove threats of violence that could lead to death or serious injury.

response.explanation: This content contains an explicit violent threat directed at a person or group. The text encoder detected high-confidence threat language (score: 0.91) mapped to the 'violent_threat' harm category. The Content Composition Graph identified a harmful_pattern edge between the subject and target nodes, corroborating the threat signal. This violates Meta Community Standards clause MCS-1.1 (Violence and Incitement).

policy_clause.title: Hate Speech
policy_clause.text: We do not allow direct attacks against people on the basis of protected characteristics.

response.explanation: This content constitutes hate speech targeting a protected group based on race, ethnicity, or religion. The text encoder assigned a high identity_hate score (0.88) via toxic-bert classification. The Content Composition Graph identified a target_pointing edge indicating a direct attack on a protected characteristic group. This violates Meta Community Standards clause MCS-3.2 (Hate Speech).

policy_clause.title: Bullying and Harassment
policy_clause.text: We remove content that targets private individuals with degradation or intimidation.

response.explanation: This content targets an individual with degrading or intimidating language. The text encoder detected severe toxic language patterns (score: 0.76) consistent with targeted harassment. The target_pointing edge in the Content Composition Graph confirms the content is directed at a specific person. This violates Meta Community Standards clause MCS-5.1 (Bullying and Harassment).

policy_clause.title: Restricted Goods — Weapons
policy_clause.section: I. Violence and Criminal Behavior — 4. Coordinating Harm and Promoting Crime
policy_clause.text: We prohibit brandishing weapons with intent to threaten or harm others.

triggered_elements.label: image
triggered_elements.full_label: a person holding a weapon and threatening another person

response.explanation: This content depicts or references weapons in a threatening context. Both text (threat score: 0.78) and image (CLIP confidence: 0.81 for 'person holding weapon threatening another person') encoders flagged harmful signals. The semantic_reference edge between text and image nodes in the Content Composition Graph confirms cross-modal corroboration, indicating emergent harm from the composition. This violates Meta Community Standards clause MCS-1.4.

policy_clause.title: Dangerous Organizations and Individuals
policy_clause.section: I. Violence and Criminal Behavior — 2. Dangerous Organizations
policy_clause.text: We remove praise, support, or representation of terrorist and hate organizations.

response.explanation: This content references or promotes a designated dangerous organization or extremist ideology. The text encoder detected severe toxicity patterns (score: 0.89) consistent with extremist content. The harmful_pattern edge in the Content Composition Graph confirms structural similarity to known extremist content patterns in the Harm Pattern Library. This violates Meta Community Standards clause MCS-2.1 (Dangerous Organizations).

policy_clause.title: Violence and Incitement
policy_clause.section: I. Violence and Criminal Behavior — 1. Violence and Incitement
policy_clause.text: We remove threats of violence that could lead to death or serious injury.

triggered_elements.label: image
triggered_elements.full_label: a person pointing a gun at someone's head

response.explanation: This content exhibits cross-modal harm emergence — neither the text nor the image alone would individually exceed the harmful threshold, but their composition creates a compound harmful signal. The text encoder scored 0.68 (borderline) while the image encoder scored 0.79. The cross-modal bonus (+0.15) was applied due to corroborating harmful signals across both modalities, pushing the final score to 0.85. This is a key capability of the CHEM system: detecting harm that only emerges from the combination of modalities.

No harmful signals detected across any modality. The text encoder returned low toxicity scores across all six toxic-bert labels (max: 0.04). The content composition graph shows no harmful_pattern edges. The final harm score of 0.04 is well below the decision threshold of 0.50. This content is classified as SAFE.

policy_clause.title: Hate Speech
policy_clause.text: We do not allow direct attacks against people on the basis of protected characteristics.

triggered_elements.label: image
triggered_elements.full_label: a hate symbol such as a swastika or burning cross

image_only_harmful.explanation: The image encoder (CLIP ViT-B/32) matched the uploaded image against harmful visual concepts with high confidence (0.83). The top matching concept was 'a hate symbol such as a swastika or burning cross', exceeding the image_harmful_min_confidence threshold of 0.45. No text was provided, but the image signal alone is sufficient to exceed the final harm threshold of 0.50. This violates Meta Community Standards clause MCS-3.2 (Hate Speech).

image_only_safe.explanation: The image encoder (CLIP ViT-B/32) evaluated the uploaded image against all harmful visual concepts. The highest confidence match was a benign concept ('a group of friends smiling at a party') with score 0.71. No harmful visual concepts exceeded the image_harmful_min_confidence threshold of 0.45. The image is classified as SAFE.

policy_clause.title: Violence and Incitement
policy_clause.section: I. Violence and Criminal Behavior — 1. Violence and Incitement
policy_clause.text: We remove threats of violence that could lead to death or serious injury.

audio_harmful.explanation: The audio encoder processed the uploaded file through Whisper (speech-to-text) and librosa (acoustic analysis). The transcript contained threatening language that scored 0.80 on the toxic-bert threat label. Additionally, the acoustic agitation ratio (sigma_ratio: 1.84) exceeded the threshold of 1.0, indicating elevated vocal stress consistent with threatening speech. The temporal_sequence edge between audio segments confirms the threat persists across the audio. This violates Meta Community Standards clause MCS-1.1 (Violence and Incitement).

audio_safe.explanation: The audio encoder processed the uploaded file. Whisper transcription returned benign speech content (threat score: 0.03). Acoustic analysis showed a normal agitation ratio (0.42), well below the threshold of 1.0. No harmful signals detected in either the transcript or acoustic features. Audio classified as SAFE.

policy_clause.title: Violent or Graphic Content
policy_clause.section: Violent or Dangerous Content — Graphic Content
policy_clause.text: Gratuitous graphic depictions intended to shock are not allowed.

triggered_elements.label: image
triggered_elements.full_label: graphic depiction of blood and physical injury on a person

video_harmful.explanation: The video encoder sampled 16 frames and ran VideoMAE action recognition alongside CLIP frame analysis. VideoMAE detected the action 'punching' with confidence 0.87, which maps to the 'graphic_violence' harm category. CLIP frame analysis on 3 sampled frames matched 'graphic depiction of blood and physical injury on a person' (confidence 0.78). The temporal_sequence edges between frame nodes confirm the violent action is sustained across multiple frames. This violates YouTube Community Guidelines clause YT-VG-2 (Violent or Graphic Content).

video_safe.explanation: VideoMAE action recognition returned no harmful action labels. CLIP frame analysis matched only benign visual concepts across all sampled frames. No temporal harm patterns detected across the video sequence. Video classified as SAFE.

default_safe_response.explanation: No harmful signals detected. All modality encoders returned scores below the decision threshold (0.50). The Content Composition Graph contains no harmful_pattern edges. Content classified as SAFE.
